privacyStatement.contentEn:
At CHON, your privacy is fundamental. We only collect the information necessary to deliver meaningful insights, and we protect it with the highest standards of security and integrity.
For individual participants, your personal information will be used solely for the following purposes:
1) To verify your eligibility for specific sections of the survey
2) To support demographic and statistical analysis
3)To generate your personalized CHON personality profile
We do not sell, share, or disclose your individual data under any circumstances. All responses are securely stored and accessible only to authorized research personnel.
privacyStatement.contentZh: 您的信息将仅用于验证目的和制定您的 CHON 性格测试。您的信息不会被共享、披露或用于任何其他目的。我们重视您的隐私，并承诺保护您的数据安全。

privacyStatement.contentEn:
At CHON, your privacy is fundamental. We only collect the information necessary to deliver meaningful insights, and we protect it with the highest standards of security and integrity.
For individual participants, your personal information will be used solely for the following purposes:
1) To verify your eligibility for specific sections of the survey
2) To support demographic and statistical analysis
3)To generate your personalized CHON personality profile
We do not sell, share, or disclose your individual data under any circumstances. All responses are securely stored and accessible only to authorized research personnel.
privacyStatement.contentZh: 您的信息将仅用于验证目的和制定您的 CHON 性格测试。您的信息不会被共享、披露或用于任何其他目的。我们重视您的隐私，并承诺保护您的数据安全。
